# Vietnamese name vocabulary, already folded (lowercase, no diacritics).
#
# The corpus test_fb_label_guard.py matches every LabelSet token against. It is
# deliberately NOT a dump of the real names this system has collected: those are
# living people, and the guard only needs the syllables, not the individuals.
#
# Two sections, because the three matching modes fail in different ways:
#
#   [syllables]  building blocks of a name. A `phrase` (substring) token is
#                unsafe the moment it fits inside one of these — "go" inside
#                "ngoc" is what discarded 107 real people. Also combined
#                pairwise, so a token containing a space can be tested.
#
#   [standalone] syllables that are complete display names on their own. Only
#                these can collide with an `exact` token, because only these
#                are ever the whole label.
#
# Add an entry whenever scripts/audit_label_collisions.py turns up a new
# collision against the live crawl. Keep it a syllable, not a person.
#
# Measured against 2,563 real author names, the syllables that cost us most:
#   ngoc, gon, gioi  contain "go"    <- "Gỡ",    107 names discarded
#   trang, chang     contain "trang" <- "Trang",  23 names discarded
#   chan, chanh      contain "chan"  <- "Chặn",    7 names discarded
#   xoan             contains "xoa"  <- "Xóa",     3 names discarded

[syllables]
